quid.definition:
n the basic unit of money in Great Britain and Northern Ireland; equal to 100 pence
n something for something; that which a party receives (or is promised) in return for something he does or gives or promises
n a wad of something chewable as tobacco
quid.translation: n. 一镑金币, 一镑, 咀嚼物

quid pro quo.translation: 报酬, 交换物, 替代物

quid pro quo-job.definition:
when someone gives a blowjob simply for a favor they will later recieve from the blowjob recipient.

formed from "quid pro quo" (that which a party is given in return for something he/she does or gives)

and "blowjob" (that which feels really goddam good when given by a skilled person)
> i get quid pro quo-jobs from my girlfriend.. she only sucks me off so i feel obligated too eat her out.

quidder.translation: n. 含在嘴里咀嚼的烟草块；咀嚼物

quidditch.translation: n. 魁地奇球赛（出自《哈利·波特》系列故事）

quiddities.translation: n. 本质( quiddity的名词复数 ); 实质; 遁词; 古怪

quiddity.definition: n. the essence that makes something the kind of thing it is and makes it different from any other
quiddity.translation: n. 本质, 实质, 吹毛求疵的意见, 怪癖

quiddle.definition:
v. i. To spend time in trifling employments, or to attend to
   useful subjects in an indifferent or superficial manner; to dawdle.
n. Alt. of Quiddler
quiddle.translation: n. 爱挑剔的人, 批评

quidnunc.definition: n a person who meddles in the affairs of others
quidnunc.translation: n. 喜欢探听别人隐私的人, 爱说长道短的人

quids.definition:
plural of quid

quids in.translation: （英, 非正式）获得利润的, 可能受益的

quidsworth.translation: n. <俚>1镑的价值, 价值1镑的东西
